verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers ships prompt/instruction files that agents invoke when a user or agent judges them relevant (e.g. 'use them every time you want to make a change'), but there is no evidence of any rule-engine or event-trigger mechanism (e.g. on git push, PR open, CI event) that automatically fires a skill without agent/user invocation. This is a plausible axis for a dev-workflow tool, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
